description: Source code for handling email notifications in Mattermost, including building email content, sending emails, and generating email subjects for different notification types.

classes.name: EmailNotification
classes.description: Data structure representing an email notification with all necessary content and context information.

methods.name: buildEmailNotification
methods.description: Constructs an EmailNotification object based on notification details, user, and team context.

methods.name: sendNotificationEmail
methods.description: Handles the process of sending an email notification, including batching, plugin hooks, and email content rendering.

methods.name: getDirectMessageNotificationEmailSubject
methods.description: Generates the email subject line for direct message notifications.

methods.name: getNotificationEmailSubject
methods.description: Generates the email subject line for general notifications.

methods.name: getGroupMessageNotificationEmailSubject
methods.description: Generates the email subject line for group message notifications.

methods.name: truncateUserNames
methods.description: Truncates user display names longer than specified length, appending ellipsis.

methods.name: GetMessageForNotification
methods.description: Retrieves the message content for a notification post.

methods.name: getNotificationEmailBodyFromEmailNotification
methods.description: Renders the email body content from an EmailNotification object and post data.
